subject: English
question_text: Change the narrative style of the following text:
stimulus: The traveller said, "Can you tell me the way to the nearest inn"? "Yes," said the peasant. "Do you want one in which you can spend the night?" "No," replied the traveller. "I only want a meal."
guide_solution: Change the narrative style: The traveller asked the peasant if he could tell him the way to the nearest inn. The peasant replied affirmatively and asked whether he wanted one where he could spend the night. The traveller answered negatively, saying that he only wanted a meal.
